plainText:
Daisuke Ono (Japanese: 小野大輔 Ono Daisuke) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Ono was born on May 4, 1978, in , , , , and became an actor as an adult. Ono first worked on the series by voicing Red Eyes in the Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs (Part 1). Ono gained his most notable role during as Galar Leon. Ono was once affiliated with before he become a freelancer. He also won Best Leading Actor Award twice during the and .
